agentRules: Use build for new graph-like diagrams.
Use inspect then patch for existing .excalidraw edits.
Do not hand-author raw Excalidraw JSON.
Use capabilities, schema, examples, and explain commands for normal discovery.
Treat editability-report failures as release blockers.
Use quality-report for structural and family quality evidence.
Sequence rendering is contract-only until a dedicated renderer is implemented.

edgeVisual.precedence: edge.visual overrides kind-based defaults in final style-edges output. kind remains the semantic relation and fallback preset.

frames.defaultPolicy: Groups and lanes are invisible unless a meaningful boundary is explicit.
frames.singletonPolicy: Automatic singleton frames are suppressed. Intentional singleton frames use groups[].singletonBoundary=true with boundaryIntent.
suppression: unspecified groups when explicit mode is active
frames.collisionPolicy: Explicit frame collisions are avoided by reducing facing padding when member-node spacing allows it. Native frame title reserve is estimated at 100% export scale.

editability.passMeaning: All semantic node labels and edges are natively bound, visible frame membership is native, and generated component details share a native group with their parent node.

quality.passMeaning: structuralPass && familyPass; not aesthetic approval. Build additionally requires editabilityPass.
